titulo: Edges first, and the middle stops being a guess
caption:
Edges first, and the middle stops being a guess

Nine pieces, one board. The edge goes down first and the middle stops being a guess.

The border is the cheap part of a puzzle, and it is also what makes the rest fit.

For whoever builds the edge of the puzzle first.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A table with a cream puzzle board on the right. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says start in the middle. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers edges first, and eight colored pieces appear one by one around the border of the board. The last dark piece drops into the middle and the blue one says huh. it fits. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me doing the edges first.
